blocks.h2: Replacing a Pump in an Old, Small Pit
blocks.body: Some older Ravenswood basements have small, shallow or unlined pits that were dug decades ago. A modern pump may not fit, or it may cycle on and off too often because the pit holds so little water. We can fit a compact pump, adjust the float or, if needed, install a new liner and a deeper pit. A pump that runs in short bursts all day wears out much faster.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of Sump Pump Work
blocks.body: The pump size and type, a backup and an alarm are the main pieces. A new liner or deeper pit adds more. We test and quote a flat price.

blocks.h2: Sump Pump Questions From Ravenswood Homeowners

items.q: Does a garden unit need a battery backup?
items.answer: Yes, if someone lives or stores things below grade.

items.q: How long do sump pumps last?
Is a sump pump the same as an ejector pump?
items.answer: No. A sump pump moves groundwater. An [ejector pump](/chicago-ravenswood/ejector-pump) moves wastewater from basement fixtures.

items.q: Can you add a sump pump to an old basement?
items.answer: Often, if water collects in one area.

items.q: Why does my pump turn on and off constantly?
items.preview: A small pit or float problem.
items.answer: Usually a small pit, a float set too low or a failed check valve.

items.q: Can you add a battery backup to an old pit?
items.answer: Usually, if the pit is large enough for two pumps.

items.q: How much does sump pump repair cost in Ravenswood?
items.preview: It depends on the pump and backup. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the pump, the pit and whether you add a backup. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
